_comment: Hand-written, matched to apply_method.py's schema (primary_channel/email/portal_url/apply_url/required_documents/notes, all required). The server_tool_use and web_search_tool_result blocks are here on purpose: the code counts searches and harvests result URLs from exactly these shapes, and tool_choice is {"type": "any"} rather than a named tool, so the mock resolves the tool from the tools list.

input.notes: Applications go through the company's own portal; no address is published in the posting.
